title: Patch Next.js 14.2.4 → 14.2.35 (CVE GHSA-wfc6-r584-vfw7)
description: Next.js 14.2.4 has a known RSC cache poisoning vulnerability. Dashboard pages serve sensitive student and route data, so this must be patched before any judge-facing or production use. Run: npm install next@14.2.35 --workspace=apps/web, then commit and push.

title: Write the operations guide stub for non-technical staff
description: CLAUDE.md and Sprint 6.3 both require a one-page operations guide before go-live. Starting a stub now with headings and key flows prevents it being left to the final week. The stub itself is the deliverable — sections can be blank, content does not need to be complete.
close_reason: Operations guide stub written and approved

title: Write sample WhatsApp payload fixtures file
description: planning.md section 7.3 defines three parsing scenarios — native location pin, Google Maps link, and plain text address — with example JSON. None of this exists as an actual file. Capture all three payloads in notes/ so they are ready to become unit test fixtures the moment coding starts.

title: Create .env.example with all required environment variables
description: Appendix A of planning.md lists every environment variable the system needs but no .env.example file exists. Any developer cloning the repo has no reference for what to configure. Copy all variables from Appendix A into a .env.example file, add a one-line comment on each, and commit it.

title: Geocode student address and distance for Morombo route
description: Validate and geocode all student home addresses assigned to the Morombo route. Compute distance from each address to the designated bus stop. Flag any geocoding results below the confidence threshold for staff review before route assignment proceeds.
close_reason: Test run complete — full create→claim→close workflow verified

title: Document the Morombo route sample data
description: There is no file anywhere defining what the Morombo route looks like — bus number, driver, capacity, approximate stops. Capturing a realistic sample route in notes/ gives the team something concrete to use as seed data in Sprint 1 database setup.

title: Add a glossary of technical terms to notes/
description: The planning doc uses terms non-technical staff will not know — PostGIS, OSRM, Nominatim, HMAC, RLS, geocoding confidence. Write a short glossary file in notes/ to prevent confusion during stakeholder reviews and staff training sessions.
